Name: Additional Special Orders
Author: atravita
Description:
Adds about 35 new special orders, including Desert Festival orders.

[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]

[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=monospace]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[b][size=5]Configuration[/size][/b]

[list=1]
[*][font=monospace]AllowedSkills[/font]: Pick which type of quests you'd like. Some quests rely on multiple skills. If so, all skills have to be enabled for the quest to be put into the pool.
[*][font=monospace]QiEnabled[/font]: True/False. Adds in the additional Qi quests.
[*][font=monospace]Repeatability[/font]: Turns on the ability of some quests to repeat. Starts off as False to give you a good chance of getting to see as many different quests as possible. (I think, however, the normal quest board does not show you repeat quests until you've exhausted the list of quests you haven't seen before.)
[*][font=monospace]Delay[/font]: To prioritize vanilla special orders, delays the custom ones. This is meant to prevent this mod from making it slower to get to Perfection, since you need recipes from vanilla special orders for that.
[*][font=monospace]Events[/font]: Some special orders come with events. Turn this off if you don't want the events to happen.
[/list]

[b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]

[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6.15+ on Linux/macOS/Windows.
[*]Works in single player, multiplayer, and split-screen mode. If in multiplayer, every player should install the mod.
[*]Should be compatible with most other mods.
[/list]

[b][size=5]See also[/size][/b]

[url=https://github.com/atravita-mods/StardewMods/tree/alpha/ContentMods]Repository[/url]
